decision: PENDING user submission. Not yet measured officially, so nothing is claimed and nothing is projected. The local evidence is an exact-output equivalence (336/336 paired cases exactly zero) plus a measured reduction in work on the has-Gram dynamic path; whether that shows up as a lisible official second is the one thing this archive cannot answer locally.
projection_note: no projection was recorded, and none is warranted. The card's own acceptance condition (plan section 4.3) is a resolvable drop in the OFFICIAL seconds, not a local one, and this machine's wall clock cannot be converted into the official machine's. Recording a local-seconds prediction here is exactly the failure mode the archive rules forbid: an unknown official result is written as unregistered/NA, never estimated.
note: The official baseline for a future reading is the v231 root at 18518 / 291s against a 300s hard limit. v235 is a descendant of that root and carries the L-EM3 K=2 arm, so a reading here is against v231 and is not additive with the v233 (L-TF1) fallback-root reading, which was priced against v230 at K=1. Every output field is bit-identical to the parent (336/336 paired cases exactly zero), so the score should be unchanged to the point; the only thing at stake is the second.
